summary_en: Target ROE 7.9%+ (shareholder cost of capital benchmark); current ROE 2.13% as of FY3/26; current PBR 0.30x. Updated capital-cost management framework effective FY3/27, superseding August 2024 policy. Detailed roadmap in attached material.
title_en: Response toward realization of capital-cost and stock-price-conscious management (Update)
translation_en_brief: Mitsuchi Corporation announced on 31 August 2026 a revised capital-cost management policy. The company has re-analysed its prior August 2024 commitment to capital-cost and stock-price-aware management and published an updated roadmap. The filing discloses three reference metrics: shareholder cost of capital target of 7.9% (the ROE floor the company aims to exceed), current ROE of 2.13% for the fiscal year ended June 2026, and a price-to-book ratio of 0.30x as of end-June 2026. The board has adopted the updated framework, effective from the fiscal year ending March 2027. Detailed targets and implementation measures are contained in the attached document.
